name: Warpline
author: CLVRKE
summary: Wavetable synth for standalone MPC built on the open-source Vital engine: plays .vital patches, 300 factory patches with type filter, velocity, six touchscreen pages. Add Vital preset banks: unzip a .vitalbank (or copy .vital files) into Warpline/Patches at the root of the drive the plugin is on, then reload Warpline. Steps in the README.
